conf.description: Linux syslog catch-all (daemon/kern/local0-7) / JSON rsyslog template: Extract JSON envelope, map typed facility/severity/appname/msgid, guard '-' placeholders. Body left unparsed by design, matching the header-only logs-system.syslog Elastic pipeline.

conf.comment: linux-syslog / syslog (catch-all) / json. The sysJSON rsyslog template types facility/severity (removing PRI/8 derivation) and separates app-name/msgid from programname, ending the RFC5424-vs-RFC3164 duplication the deployed map has to reconcile. Body (msg) is left unparsed by design -- logs-system.syslog is a header-only Elastic pipeline, so there is no body grammar to gain here.
